review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 25 physical pages against the OCR Markdown (HTML stripped, hyphenated line breaks un-joined, inline math marked); no code fences exist in the source. All decimal values in Tables 1-7 match the PDF text layer as multisets (the lone 70.51 difference is the OCR's \% escape, which renders correctly). Bracketed reference years ((2020)x1, (2022)x1, (2023)x3, (2024)x17, (2025)x2) and accented names (Defossez, Pegoroski-style entries) match the print exactly; PDF-side 'efossez'/'egou'/'erez' tokens are accent-combining extraction artifacts. Figure-internal labels (architecture diagram, dataset icons) and the arXiv stamp account for all remaining PDF-only tokens. The remaining PDF-only '1https:' was a genuinely dropped footnote body, restored here. Visual verification at 300 dpi: p.1 abstract hyphen break, p.16 footnote, p.19 'benckmark', p.20 Table 5 caption.
